question: Can an explicitly typed diagonal prediction-error variance state supply the recurrent uncertainty/coherence signal missing from the state-independent source while eliminating the four non-tail safety failures retained by the generic multistate observer?

parent_evidence.interpretation: Recurrent context is required across nearly the full population, but generic latent channels do not encode the uncertainty needed to control four hard non-tail networks.

data.host_rule: Use the old deterministic host unless max(final_layer_mse,max_layer_mse)>5e-7; all 11 such ranks must use the near-floor-min repair.

architecture.name: typed diagonal-error-variance physical observer
architecture.nonnegative_variance_state: v_l, the diagonal conditional prediction-error variance
architecture.cell_inputs: standardized raw20 plus m_l/R_l, m_l/(sigma_l R_l), log1p(p_l/R_l^2), and m_l/sqrt(p_l+epsilon)
architecture.cell: Shared two-layer H96 SiLU trunk with layer-specific signed-source, bounded-mean-gain, and positive-variance-innovation heads.
architecture.material_difference: Three unconstrained latent residual channels are replaced by one explicitly nonnegative variance state with typed W^2 covariance transport.

training.primary_loss: Fit-fold-normalized corrected-layer rollout MSE with fixed layer weights linearly increasing 0.5 to 1.5, plus equal final-layer focus.
training.typed_state_loss: Fixed coefficient 0.05 times normalized heteroscedastic Gaussian score log(s_l+1e-4)+z_l^2/(s_l+1e-4), where z_l=(truth_l-mu_l)/R_l and s_l=v_l/R_l^2.
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch 6 in every fold; no checkpoint selection.

decision_gate.pass: Every rollout is finite AND OOF final-layer MSE <2.9672528546945005e-8 AND maximum per-network final-layer MSE <1e-7.
decision_gate.fail: Any conjunct fails; close this exact typed diagonal-variance form measured and do not meter or deploy it.

cost_contract.requirement: Preserve this frozen structural estimate; run a literal flopscope meter only after the accuracy gate passes.

outcome.pass: Promote the typed variance mechanism for literal deployment construction and a separately frozen sub-1e-8 successor.
outcome.fail: Close P2R0F2I measured; retain the broader autonomous residual problem open.
